The '''Republic tugboat''', also called the '''interstellar tug''', was a model of support ship used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:InterstellarTug-BI.png|thumb|left|200px|A tug guides ''TB-73'' into Ord Cestus medical station]]
The ship had two [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors on the front to help [[Starship/Legends|starships]] dock at [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], like the [[Ord Cestus medical station/Legends|Ord Cestus medical station]]. The tugs were piloted by two [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]].<ref name="BI" />

==History==
This type of vessel was first seen at the Ord Cestus medical station, where it helped [[Pelta-class frigate/Legends|''Pelta''-class frigates]] and other ships to dock at the station. Two of these tugs helped the [[Brain worm/Legends|brain worm]]-infected [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] [[TB-73/Legends|''TB-73'']] dock at the medical station. The infected [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] had taken over the vessel and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] were trying to gain control back.<ref name="BI" />

Tano had started the ship's cooling system, because the brain worms couldn't handle the freezing temperatures. Offee was infected too and there was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] battle between the Padawans on the main bridge. With no one at the controls, the ship was set on a high-speed collision course at the medical station. The two tugs had to use their tractor beam projectors at full power to prevent the frigate from crashing into the station.<ref name="BI" />

Tugs were also used to move the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] to the vicinity of the [[Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Kaliida Nebula]] after its refurbishing by the Republic.<ref name="TCW:TVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>
